plan.title: Harden festina-quick with verification, retry, and parity fixes
plan.overview: Add lightweight quality gates to festina-quick that other skills already have: anti-pattern scan after implementation, retry loop in the shared directive-compliance partial, research override option, approach confirmation pause, skill-complete partial usage, and doc list command flags. All changes target two Handlebars-templated Markdown files in src/content/.

approach.rationale:
Two files need modification: 1. SKILL.md (the quick skill source) — gains 4 new process steps/modifications and 2 context flags. Follows existing step patterns already in SKILL.md (e.g., auto_decide_research at lines 93-107, determine_approach at lines 163-174). 2. directive-compliance.md (shared partial) — gains a retry loop after "Fix now" selection. Follows the inline retry pattern already in festina-implement's SKILL.md at lines 279-285.
The skill-complete partial (apps/festinalente/src/content/partials/skill-complete.md) already exists as a single-line drop-in — quick just needs to reference it via Handlebars.
The product-docs-scripts and engineering-docs-scripts partials already support show_list_* flags (product-docs-scripts.md:3, engineering-docs-scripts.md:3) — quick's context section just needs to pass them.
Edit order: shared partial first (task 1), then quick skill changes (tasks 2-6), so the retry loop is available when quick's directive-compliance step runs.

change.old: Directive compliance: user selects "Fix now" → fix applied → execution continues (no re-check)
change.new: Directive compliance: user selects "Fix now" → fix applied → failed checks re-run → if still failing, report and continue

task.name: Add retry loop to shared directive-compliance partial
task.action:
- Read the current directive-compliance.md partial (37 lines) - After the existing "Fix now" branch (where user selects "Fix now" and the fix is applied), add a retry sub-branch: 1. After fix is applied, re-run ONLY the failed validation checks (not all checks) 2. If checks now pass, continue normally 3. If still failing after remediation, output the remaining failures and continue execution - The "Continue anyway" branch remains unchanged - When no directives are loaded (empty directive list), the step already exits early — verify this behavior is preserved (FR8)
Current code (directive-compliance.md lines 23-36, approximate): ```markdown <branch condition="any check fails"> <output>Directive violation: {check id} - {reason}</output> <action>Find example elements where ref matches failed check</action> <action>Show violation examples to illustrate the problem</action> <action>Show correct examples to illustrate the fix</action> <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "Violation" - question: "Directive check failed. How would you like to proceed?" - options: - label: "Fix now", description: "Address the violation before continuing" - label: "Continue anyway", description: "Acknowledge and proceed despite violation" - multiSelect: false </action> </branch> ```
Change to (add after AskUserQuestion): ```markdown <branch condition="user selects Fix now"> <action>Attempt remediation for the violation</action> <action>Re-run the failed validation checks (only the ones that failed, not all checks)</action> <branch condition="checks now pass"> <output>Violation resolved.</output> </branch> <branch condition="still failing after remediation"> <output>Violation persists after fix attempt: {check id} - {reason}. Continuing.</output> </branch> </branch> ```
task.done: Directive-compliance partial has retry loop: fix → re-run failed checks → report if still failing. Existing "Continue anyway" path unchanged. No-directive case still passes silently.

task.name: Add doc list flags to quick skill context
task.done: Quick skill context section includes both search and list command variants for product and engineering docs

task.name: Add research override option to auto_decide_research
task.pattern: AskUserQuestion pattern used elsewhere in SKILL.md (e.g., ask_problem at line 72)
task.action:
- In the auto_decide_research step (lines 93-107), modify the "simple task" branch - Instead of silently setting doResearch = false, show the decision and offer an override
Current code (SKILL.md lines 99-102): ```markdown <branch condition="simple task"> <action>Set doResearch = false</action> <output>Simple task — skipping codebase research.</output> </branch> ```
Change to: ```markdown <branch condition="simple task"> <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "Research" - question: "Simple task detected — skipping codebase research. Override?" - options: - label: "Skip research", description: "Proceed without codebase research (recommended)" - label: "Research anyway", description: "Explore the codebase before implementing" - multiSelect: false </action> <branch condition="user selects Skip research"> <action>Set doResearch = false</action> </branch> <branch condition="user selects Research anyway"> <action>Set doResearch = true</action> </branch> </branch> ```
- The "complex task" branch remains unchanged (always researches)
task.done: When auto_decide_research determines "simple", user sees the decision and can override to research anyway

task.name: Add approach confirmation pause before implementation
task.pattern: AskUserQuestion pattern used in SKILL.md ask_problem step (line 72)
task.action:
- After the determine_approach step (lines 163-174) and before the implement step (line 176), add a confirmation prompt - Insert after the approach output and before the implement step
After the determine_approach step's output block (after line 174), add: ```markdown <step name="confirm_approach"> <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "Confirm" - question: "Proceed with this approach?" - options: - label: "Proceed", description: "Start implementation with the approach above" - label: "Adjust", description: "I'd like to change the approach" - multiSelect: false </action> <branch condition="user selects Adjust"> <action>Ask user what to change about the approach</action> <action>Update approach, constraints, and/or verify sections in quick.xml</action> <action>Re-display updated approach</action> </branch> </step> ```
task.done: After determine_approach displays the approach, user can confirm or adjust before implementation begins

task.name: Add anti-pattern scan after implementation
task.action:
- After the proceed_to_finalization step (lines 182-184) and before the directive-compliance partial (line 186), insert a new verify_implementation step - This is a lightweight version of festina-implement's anti_pattern_scan (lines 368-400) - Only scan files listed in quick.xml's files section (FR5 — exclude unmodified files)
Insert between proceed_to_finalization and directive-compliance: ```markdown <step name="verify_implementation"> <note>Lightweight quality scan — check modified files for incomplete work markers</note> <action>Read quick.xml files section to get list of modified/created files</action> <action>Grep ONLY those files for: TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX</action> <branch condition="markers found"> <output> WARNING: Found incomplete work markers in modified files: </output> <action>List each finding with file:line reference</action> <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "Anti-patterns" - question: "Found {n} incomplete markers (TODO, FIXME, etc) in modified files. How to proceed?" - options: - label: "Fix now", description: "Address these markers before continuing" - label: "Proceed anyway", description: "These are intentional or will be addressed later" - multiSelect: false </action> <branch condition="user selects Fix now"> <action>Fix the markers</action> <action>Re-run the scan to confirm</action> </branch> </branch> <branch condition="no markers found"> <note>Silent pass — no output needed</note> </branch> </step> ```
task.done: After implementation, modified files are scanned for TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX. Only files from quick.xml files section are scanned. User warned with file:line references if markers found.

task.name: Replace inline [FESTINA_COMPLETE] with skill-complete partial
task.action:
- In the output_result step (lines 229-236), replace the inline [FESTINA_COMPLETE] with the Handlebars partial reference
Current code (SKILL.md line 235): ```markdown <output>[FESTINA_COMPLETE]</output> ```
Change to: ```markdown {{> skill-complete}} ```
- This makes quick consistent with the other 15 skills that use the partial
task.done: Quick skill output uses skill-complete partial instead of inline [FESTINA_COMPLETE] text

testing.automated: None — these are Markdown/Handlebars template changes verified by build
testing.manual: - Run /festina-quick on a simple task — verify research override prompt appears - Verify approach confirmation prompt appears before implementation - Verify anti-pattern scan runs after implementation (add a TODO to test) - Verify [FESTINA_COMPLETE] still appears in output (now via partial) - Verify list-product and list-engineering commands appear in compiled skill - Load a directive with a failing check — verify retry loop: fix → re-check → report
testing.regression: - Verify all 16 skills using directive-compliance partial still build - Verify "Continue anyway" path in directive compliance still works (no retry) - Verify complex tasks in auto_decide_research still auto-research without prompt - Verify no-directive case passes silently

case.scenario: No directives loaded for quick task

edge-cases.case: Directive compliance step exits early — no retry loop or prompts shown (FR8). Verified by existing early-exit in load_directives.
Only files from quick.xml files section are scanned — pre-existing markers in other files are ignored (FR5).

case.scenario: User selects Adjust on approach confirmation

edge-cases.case: Approach is re-collected and re-displayed; loop until user confirms or runs out of adjustments.

case.scenario: Retry loop fix succeeds on second attempt

edge-cases.case: Failed checks re-run after fix, pass, and execution continues normally with success message.

case.scenario: Retry loop fix fails after remediation

edge-cases.case: Remaining failures reported to user, execution continues (does not block indefinitely).

pitfalls.pitfall: Retry only activates when user selects "Fix now" — existing flow for "Continue anyway" is unchanged. Backward compatible because the new branch is additive.

pitfall.issue: Editing built output instead of source

pitfalls.pitfall: Directive F1: all edits must be in apps/festinalente/src/content/, not .claude/ or .opencode/. Build with pnpm festinalente:build to verify.
Ensure partial invocations use correct syntax: {{> partial-name flag=true}}. Build will fail silently on bad syntax (copies raw source instead).
